# Protected Sudoku checker fixtures

These synthetic rectangle fixtures test the agreement's composition and evidence
contracts without launching a browser or running product code. They are not
candidate screenshots or product acceptance proof.

The real fixed command builds the assigned read-only candidate in owned scratch,
then opens configured Chrome for Testing and Playwright WebKit through Runner.
Its archive records fresh and in-progress geometry, actual UI journeys, full
viewport images, source/runtime identities and cleanup. Visual judgment remains
an independent role's responsibility. No native/physical Safari or release
approval is inferred.

Three focused Chromium desktop neighbor smokes protect the changed shared
PlayerLayout/PlaySettings/PlayerActions boundary: Suguru's under-board controls
and input/Undo, plus a small Nonogram and Shikaku input/Undo/geometry check.
Only rendered primary controls and Undo enter that geometry check; secondary
Redo/Check/Restart do not become primary targets. Desktop vertical scrolling is
allowed, while target size, horizontal containment, frame clipping, under-board
placement and non-overlap remain required. Every actual action scrolls normally
when allowed, then independently checks its fresh enabled/hit-tested centre.
Mouse actions first move the pointer normally and allow hover rendering before
that final hit test. A previous hover may disappear; a persistent overlay still
fails. Touch actions do not gain a mouse move or a coverage exemption.
Nonogram reopens its normal public 5×5 catalogue code; it does not waive or claim
New-generation qualification. These are separate from the Sudoku matrix and do
not multiply themes, viewports or engine benchmarks for neighboring games.

The browser contract fixtures also protect native-DOM versus Playwright selector
boundaries, bounded locator diagnostics, and one shared public-code reopen before
the viewport matrix. A failed prerequisite leaves dependent work explicitly unrun.
Partial collection retains its canonical browser evidence and first failure while
remaining blocked; absent acceptance rows are never counted as passing.

Disabled tools retain all geometry obligations without being required to receive
pointer events. The real entry/Undo/Redo journeys exercise their enabled state.
History is tested before reload; the authored reload contract persists progress
and starts fresh history. Home continuation binds the exact admitted board and
accepts the authored “Open to check” action when a discovered save is unloaded.
In-play New puzzle uses one shared driver: use its visible heading/standalone
affordance or open Options and activate its scoped button. Completion-dialog
actions remain separate. The same trusted activation and visibility/disabled/
coverage checks apply to either affordance.

Actions and resizes retain bounded before/after viewport, scroll, geometry,
selection and focus facts. Resize setup does not force cell focus or reset page
scroll after Options. Failure images are captured before the owning context closes;
the 80 planned images leave four diagnostic slots within the 84-image
limit. Repeated geometry failures identify a representative image and retain each
failed state's own metrics; omitted images are explicit, never passing evidence.

The 16 November owner-feedback contract extends the existing 20 journeys and
146 geometry observations. Repeated entry in Options, More actions, Unlock
highlight and lock explanation prose must be absent. Check/Restart share a
separate row above the board on its right; their secondary geometry is measured
relative to the real primary controls rather than a new fixed target-size gate.
Both completion journeys lock a digit through trusted Shift+digit input, enter
all nine copies, and verify disabled semantics/appearance while retaining its
actual lime highlight. Phone hints retain explanation/apply/Undo coverage and
desktop hints must expose actual nonempty explanation content. Four added images
show the exhausted locked phone control and working desktop hint in each engine.

Focus-clock evidence uses a controlled Playwright clock and an owned headless
Chromium window target or WebKit page. It records actual document focus,
visibility and trusted blur events, checks background time is never charged on
return, and preserves manual pause and Show timer preference. A hidden-tab
transition does not establish blur-while-visible; the exact scope remains in the
receipt and the focused frontend clock regression must cover visible window blur.
Native OS-window behavior remains unqualified. Every focus target/context is
closed in finally cleanup. Complete owner-feedback receipts are an acceptance
requirement and remain visible in the compact protected summary.

The `admit-followup` mode authenticates the exact accepted checker archive,
source inventory and original physical-workspace handoff before a developer can
start. It forwards only the unchanged small receipt, never restores source or
runs builds/tests/browsers. A rejection creates no ready domain or handoff
artifact. Fixture tests cover accepted source and archive/source/handoff/marker
or stale-output refusal without running product code.
Reusable admission receives `--request {goal}` and binds the prior archive/source
to `accepted_candidate` in that immutable owner goal. An optional direct-fixture
digest must agree when both mechanisms are supplied. The normal checker hashes
the same exact goal bytes. Its explicit `--preview-root` retains each goal under
that request SHA256, preserving earlier accepted previews; legacy exact
`--preview` semantics remain unchanged.

One explicit authored best-effort tracker contract covers only POST event and
page-view ingestion. Its 4xx and transport failures remain visible diagnostics;
gameplay/unrecognized HTTP errors, all API 5xx and page exceptions still block
acceptance. Unknown API transport handling is unchanged. This classification
does not claim analytics works or weaken any journey/geometry assertion.

Request-time snapshots retain the initiating journey/viewport and a public route
category, plus known telemetry payload shape, size/hash and safe event dimensions.
Puzzle codes, query/fragment values, full referrers, unrecorded field names, private
API payloads and raw bodies are excluded. Small declared uncompressed response
bodies (at most 1KiB) retain only size/hash and a recognized server-error category;
otherwise the body is explicitly unavailable. No extra request, HAR or trace is
created. At most the existing 30 errors and 30 diagnostics receive body enrichment.
Only actual failing HTTP responses enqueue that work: it drains before context
close and archive finalization, including close-time responses. The existing 12s
browser deadline aborts stalled body collection; unavailable body facts and a
timeout count remain visible without failing gameplay for optional diagnostics.
An abortable read settles enrichment independently of a stuck body promise;
late completion cannot overwrite its unavailable facts. Real cleanup errors still
propagate. No network-idle or header wait is added to
ordinary navigation. The payload projection counts unrecorded fields and does
not claim to validate the complete server DTO.
